input.quote: 14.2 Vendor exclusively owns every Deliverable created for Customer. Customer receives a revocable, non-transferable licence to use a Deliverable only during the applicable Order Form term.
input.rationale: The primary grants meet the preferred position: § 13.1 extends the Services licence to Affiliates and contractors acting on our behalf, § 13.2 gives a perpetual, irrevocable, fully paid licence to delivered/embedded Vendor Technology for Customer and Affiliates with contractor support, and § 13.3 permits transfer to an Affiliate or successor and limits revocation/suspension to uncured material breach after notice and cure. The gap is § 14.2: the Deliverable licence is expressly revocable, non-transferable, limited to the Order Form term and silent on Affiliates and contractors, which is walk-away territory (revocable at Vendor's discretion with no affiliate/contractor path) and is not cured by § 10.1, which preserves Deliverable rights only "according to their terms". The redline conforms § 14.2 to the licence terms already agreed in §§ 13.1-13.3 and leaves the Deliverable ownership question to the IP rule so the same term is not flagged twice.

proposal.summary: Make the Deliverable licence perpetual/irrevocable and extend it to Affiliates, contractors and successors
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept a Deliverable licence that Vendor may revoke at will and that ends with the Order Form term, so we have made it perpetual and irrevocable (subject to the existing Section 13.3 breach carve-out) and extended it to our Affiliates, contractors acting on our behalf, and a permitted successor. This aligns Section 14.2 with the licence terms already agreed in Sections 13.1-13.3; at a minimum we need Affiliate coverage and successor transferability.

ops.oldText: Customer receives a revocable, non-transferable licence to use a Deliverable only during the applicable Order Form term.
ops.newText: Customer, its Affiliates, and contractors acting on their behalf receive a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence to use each Deliverable for their internal business purposes, transferable to an Affiliate or successor in connection with an assignment permitted by Section 24 and revocable or suspendable only as permitted by Section 13.3.
